notes: Account summary: EU-headquartered fintech focusing on B2B payments. High regulatory bar (BaFin + GDPR).
Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed control plane (no egress to non-EU regions).

SCIM: Must support SCIM 2.0 for provisioning; core attributes: userName, displayName, mail, externalId; group-sync required (mapping to RBAC roles).

KMS: BYOK required. Customer uses AWS KMS with a dedicated CMK in eu-central-1 and an HSM-backed key policy. Need envelope encryption flow and key rotation notes.
Audit logging: Immutable logs forwarded to their Splunk cluster via S3 -> ingestion; retention 7 years; need proof of log integrity (digest/HMAC) and access controls on logs.
Data residency: Must guarantee tokens and KV cache never leave eu-central-1 for Private deployment; legal insisted on data flow diagram for procurement.
Performance targets for POC: median generation latency < 120ms for chat baseline (50 token responses) and sustained 200 RPS for reranking micro-batch.
